yoloConfirmTitle: Enable Real YOLO (skip all permission prompts)?
yoloConfirmBody: Enabling Real YOLO sends skipPermissionsUnsafe to Droid CLI. Droid will no longer prompt for permission and will run any command — including destructive operations like deleting files, pushing code, or irreversible shell commands — without confirmation.
yoloConfirmWarning: This setting only affects the current session and is cleared automatically when you switch away from YOLO. Only enable it in a trusted, sandboxed environment.
yoloConfirmConfirmButton: I understand the risk, enable Real YOLO
